log.notes_to_self: Strategy: quick kills ONLY in afternoon (keeps night/student/home = 55% of people). National-reported criminals are free to kill because a trace reveals nothing. Avoid single-niche criminals (radio/blotter/foreign alone), since each traced one cuts the pool to about 25%. Multi-outlet ones like forum+East narrow only to about 44%, and repeats of the same combination add nothing new. Day1: killed d1-1 (natl+forum), d1-9 and d1-11 (forum+East), all afternoon. Expected pool around 24k. Watch the press conference after day 3.

Strategy: quick kills ONLY in the afternoon. That keeps night workers, students and people at home, about 55% of people. National-reported criminals are free to kill because a trace reveals nothing. Plan: deliberately settle my identity as a FORUM reader (est. pool after day 2 about 13-14k, i.e. 55% routine x 25% forum). After that, any criminal shown in forum (alone or with others) costs nothing more, so kill all forum-tagged criminals. Avoid criminals tagged only blotter, radio, foreign or East with no forum. Each of those cuts the pool by about 4x and risks going under 1,000. Multiplier: doubling needs 30 kills in the last 5 days (6 a day), quadrupling needs 40 (8 a day). Aim for as many forum and national kills as I can. Day1 killed d1-1 (national+forum), d1-9 and d1-11 (forum+East). Day2 killed d2-11 (national+forum), d2-8 (forum+East), d2-6 and d2-9 (forum only), all afternoon. Check the press conference after day 3. Expect about 10-20k. If it is below 5k, stop narrowing completely.
